crossRefs.note: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
“Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?
Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.
I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.
But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
“You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

translations.web: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that you will not hold me innocent.
translations.bsb: I would still dread all my sufferings; I know that You will not acquit me.
translations.kjv: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
translations.asv: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
